## Constraints

### Must

- Use registry files as the catalog source of truth.
- Keep LL Core as the only UI kit inheritance root.
- Keep package approval separate from Codex skill promotion.
- Support light, dark, and reduced-motion behavior.

### Avoid

- CMS, database, authentication, and drag-drop builder behavior.
- Pervasive blue, glass, gradients, decorative motion, and rounded-everything styling.
- Production imports from `@loomlogic/labs` by default.

## Decisions

- Use a calm neutral editorial workbench with a compact package rail, centered preview canvas, and right-side property inspector.
- Use semantic React primitives with explicit APIs and no new runtime UI dependency for V1.
